latestVersion.changelog:
Vheer AI Image to Video v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly animate single or multiple images into cinematic video clips with natural motion.
- Handles user-friendly requests for uploads, animation, motion style, credits, export, and status.
- Automatic connection and session management (including token handling for free or registered users).
- Supports a wide range of media formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, gif, jpg, png, etc.).
- Guides users with helpful prompts and concise feedback throughout the workflow.
- Integrates robust error handling for smooth user experience.
